id: title:Gilbert09:retry transient read timeouts copying query files

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion pipeline reliability: classifies S3 read timeouts and connection drops as transient errors to support retry behavior.
review.reason: Adds botocore.exceptions.HTTPClientError and ReadTimeoutError to the transient error classification, and documents the distinction between bare HTTPClientError and OSError. This supports warehouse ingestion recovery, though the actual retry implementation and classification changes are not present in this chunk.
review.uncertainty: This chunk lacks the implementation of the retry behavior and the underlying classification changes; tier relies on the assumption that those changes exist and are effective.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new exception class or the actual retry behavior, only the classification and test. The connection to PostHog relies on the assumption that the underlying retry and classification changes exist and are effective.

observations.behavior: Adds botocore.exceptions.HTTPClientError to the set of transient object store errors recognized by is_transient_object_store_error.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion pipeline to recognize S3 read timeouts and connection drops as transient and retry them, rather than failing immediately.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation explaining that bare HTTPClientError represents S3 read timeouts or connection drops not translated to OSError by s3fs.
observations.code_quote: A read that times out or a connection the object store drops mid-response surfaces as a bare
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the classification behavior for transient errors, supporting the retry mechanism.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case asserting that botocore.exceptions.ReadTimeoutError is classified as a transient error.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the classification of S3 read timeouts.
